_note: Per reworked gun: the OLD sizes the double-size version is derived from (so a re-run never doubles twice). menu_w = content width of the old 64x32 menu picture; inhand = the old in-hand picture's canvas (w, h; its content fills it); grips = the old WeaponArt.Grips row in the OLD in-hand pixels (grip x, y, support x, y, muzzle x, y; null = none).
